title: Rafael Uribe Uribe Palace of Culture

groundCutout.basis: The original source field rises above the lower courtyard level. Bound the display opening to the mapped court and retain every original terrain sample.

buildingCutout.basis: The named building multipolygon fixes the outer masonry footprint.

terrainReference.basis: Independent ground at the central approach from Plaza Botero.

mapIdentity.provider: The named building relation 7460245 supplies the exact mapped outer outline and the open court. The Antioquia cultural institute identifies the work of architect Agustín Goovaerts and the later completion of the built palace.

identities.name: Rafael Uribe Uribe Palace of Culture

names: Rafael Uribe Uribe Palace of Culture
mapIdentity.scope: Named OpenStreetMap building relation 7460245 pins the outer outline and courtyard. Exact November 2006 photographs control the checker masonry, street and south entrances, cupola and inner windows. A verified 2017 view locates the surviving pale plaza-side massing.

note: The plaza approach defines model zero in the original Terrarium field. The three street facade levels, lower storey and slate dome proportions are inferred from dated photographs. The courtyard floor is estimated independently of DEM surface heights under the building.
